incarnation: Imperium Aeternum — selected Cassian Varro V2 internal original-project portrait2026

references.provenance: Exact selected local V2 restored by root from matching LFS object, actually opened by producer.

silhouette: Broad-shouldered human centurion; short black tousled hair, no helmet. Tattered deep burgundy cape and layered knee-length burgundy tunic with leather pteruges.
anatomy: Two ordinary human arms/hands and two legs; athletic stocky proportions shown by selected portrait.
face: Tan warm complexion, dark eyebrows and eyes, short dark stubble, angular nose and jaw. Tiny facial marks remain ambiguous pixels, not invented scars.
costume: Dark segmented metal cuirass and shoulder plates edged warm gold, crossed brown leather chest straps, round gold cape brooch, broad brown belt with square gold buckle, metal studs on leather skirt strips; dark gold-trim greaves and open-toed brown strapped sandals.
palette: Deep burgundy/crimson cloth, charcoal steel, brown leather, worn warm gold and silver blade.
equipment: Anatomical RIGHT hand carries short straight silver gladius with gold guard and dark/gold hilt; anatomical LEFT arm carries tall rounded-rectangular burgundy scutum, worn gold border, central gold boss and diagonal gold lines. The gold-hilted sheathed object at left belt is not independently identified.
distinguishingMarks: Unhelmeted black-haired centurion with large wine-red gold scutum, tattered wine-red cape and gold circular brooch.
forbiddenMixes: No blue modern jacket, white shirt, trousers, cowboy hair or unarmed generic brawler from historical atlas. No mirrored sword/shield hands, helmet, pilum or invented animal.

scopeLimitations: Single selected front-three-quarter internal project portrait; no external franchise certification.
Back of armor, scutum reverse, unreadable insignia and tiny face marks are unknown. Keep those views cautious. Absolute 1:1 is not certified.
Chronological age undocumented; same apparent source proportions, fully clothed family-safe nonromantic art.
Old atlas actually opened: brown-haired civilian in blue jacket, pale shirt, trousers and boots is substantially divergent; old bytes preserved.
Original world-compatible environments are interpretations; CG05 Nexus adaptation, CG09-11 fan art, CG12-15 hypothetical What If, no canon chronology claim.

incarnationDecision.reason: Selected V2 centurion equipment and costume differ substantially from old civilian brawler.

manifestContext.actualRecordRead: cassian_varro: centurion of dissolved legion refusing emperor without people; gladius, tank/formation. World Forum of Four Eras, Vestal Fire Siege, Bifrons Gate.
